data.description: Driving sleet blocks all sight [even darkvision] within it and causes the ground in the area to be icy. A creature can walk within or through the area of sleet at half normal speed with a DC 10 Acrobatics check. Failure means it can't move in that round, while failure by 5 or more means it falls [see the Acrobatics skill for details]. The sleet extinguishes torches and small fires.
